query:
UPDATE videos
         SET title = $3,
             updated_at = timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond'
         WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_videos cv
                       WHERE cv.org_id = $1 AND cv.video_id = $2 AND cv.course_id = ANY($4))
